title: Sparkline hero with stepwise screenshot timeline for quickstart landing
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Refresh the Quickstart landing hero with a compact, scannable visual that communicates time-to-first-result and the core 4-step setup flow. This ticket delivers a 'sparkline' hero treatment (a thin horizontal progress visualization) paired with a stepwise screenshot timeline that visually anchors each step to an illustrative product screenshot. The treatment must be readable at small widths and usable as the primary hero for the Quickstart landing (marketing + in-product). Scope: - Hi-fi Figma hero composition with two variants: Static PNG fallback and animated Lottie/web-anim (small file, autoplay muted) that animates the sparkline and transitions between screenshots. - Screenshot timeline: 4 discrete frames with microcopy overlays that map to onboarding tasks (API key, model selection, sample request, view logs). Screenshots generated by the screenshot pipeline; we will include a 'clean' chrome-less export. - Microcopy and CTA: short headline, 10–12 word subhead explaining expected time-to-first-result, single primary CTA (Get started) + secondary text link (See examples). - Accessibility: all hero text must be real HTML (not part of image), color contrast >= 4.5:1 for body copy on hero, motion reduces via prefers-reduced-motion. - Responsive behavior: hero compresses to a single-column stack at <= 640px; sparkline collapses to a compact badge and screenshots become a single carousel swipe. Deliverables / Acceptance criteria: 1) Figma file with named layers and tokens (colors, spacing, type styles) exported to the design library. 2) 3 export sets: hero_lg@2x.png, hero_md@2x.png, hero_fallback.svg (static). 3) Lottie file <= 150KB; animation toggles off when prefers-reduced-motion is set. 4) Screenshot tiles: 4 hi-res PNGs (1280x720) plus 3 responsive sizes for pipeline. Screenshots must be generated from staging account with deterministic data and anonymized tokens. 5) Markup spec: annotated CSS classes and breakpoints, copy strings, and analytics event names: quickstart.hero.cta_click, quickstart.hero.animation_played, quickstart.timeline.step_viewed. 6) Sign-off from PM (Jorge Kim) and Eng lead for screenshot pipeline (Melanie Zhou). Design decisions / trade-offs: - Chose sparkline over giant device mock to keep visual density low and ensure the hero scales well inside marketing email previews and small product nav contexts. - Use animated transition for hosted marketing page, but provide static fallback for resource-constrained embeds and docs. - Screenshot timeline intentionally minimal (no explanatory overlays beyond 1–2 word labels) to avoid localization bloat; full explanatory bullets available in the body copy below the hero. Implementation notes for Eng: - Lottie will be embedded via style wrapper or JSON loader; fallback for non-supporting clients. Provide data-attributes for analytics. - Screenshot exports live in Drive: drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Qk_SparklineExports (shared with eng/design). Export script: github.com/redwood-inference/screenshot-pipeline#sparkline-exports. - Hook required: ENG-37120 (screenshot sanitization) must be completed before final assets are exported. Handoff checklist: - Add Figma link to PR (design PR must include export zip). - Provide CSS snippet with breakpoints and variables. - Accessibility pass and contrast report (include small report in Figma comments). Stakeholders and reviewers: - PM reviewer: Jorge Kim - Eng reviewer: Melanie Zhou - UX research: Priya Nair (microcopy A/B guidance) Notes on analytics & experiments: - Default variant serves static image; experiment variant serves Lottie for users in marketing cohorts. Track conversions via quickstart.hero.variant and quickstart.hero.cta_click. Risks & mitigation: - Motion performance on low-end devices: cap Lottie complexity and include static PNG fallback. - Screenshot leaks: ensure sanitization script is run and staging accounts scrubbed. Links and artifacts: - Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/Redwood/quickstart-sparkline-hero-2026 - Screenshot pipeline docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/screenshot-pipeline#readme - Design token library entry: https://design.redwood.ai/tokens/quickstart-hero - Preliminary prototype (InVision/Lottie preview): https://invisionapp.com/sparkline-prototype
